source_name: SDA Hymnal Yoruba by Fisayo Afolayan
source_license: MIT (see source LICENSE); credit source and retain license if reusing
upstream_readme_use_policy: Upstream README explicitly invites third-party app reuse with source credit
notes: This index is a map to online FULL Yoruba SDA lyrics, not a claim that SDA translations equal TAC Nigeria printed Redemption verses. No full lyrics are copied into TAC app. Human review of variant words, stanzas, and edition-specific versions is necessary. Distinct entries for the same English original can differ in tune or verses.
